snippet_primary: "Etsy advertises that it takes around 3.5% commission on sales, which is of course very low. Unfortunately, that is simply not true. If you tot up all the additional fees the actual figure is closer to 15%. And that's before you've paid for postage, any marketing fees and local taxes."
